Moderate temperature (about 400–450°C): a lower temperature gives a higher yield (exothermic) but too slow a rate, so a compromise is used, with an iron catalyst.
High pressure (about 200 atm) favours the side with fewer gas moles, increasing yield and rate, but very high pressure is too costly and dangerous.
Ammonia is removed as it forms and unreacted gases are recycled.
